boundary_atlas.axes: plus or minus e1 are elliptic-elliptic, plus or minus e2 are saddle-center, and plus or minus e3 are saddle-saddle
boundary_atlas.coordinate_faces: x_i=p_i=0 is an invariant T-star S1 Neumann subsystem
boundary_atlas.double_spectrum: the SO(2) angular momentum and the simple-axis Uhlenbeck integral commute, satisfy the exact energy identity, and are independent on a nonempty open set
boundary_atlas.isotropic: zero speed gives the equilibrium sphere and nonzero speed gives great circles of least period 2*pi/speed
boundary_atlas.quantum: natural compact quantization does not imply a target-zero operator
boundary_atlas.regular_only: Liouville two-torus topology is asserted only on connected regular common fibers
boundary_atlas.singular_fibers: no exhaustive topology is claimed beyond the explicitly declared axial, coordinate, and spectrum-degenerate faces

collision_boundary.C186: Euler top is a Lie-Poisson kinetic system, not a holonomic anisotropic sphere potential
collision_boundary.C244: spherical pendulum has a linear height potential and focus-focus monodromy, not Uhlenbeck resolvent integrals
collision_boundary.C313: round-sphere geodesics are the isotropic boundary, not the distinct-spectrum Neumann system
collision_boundary.C344: resonant triad has a cubic intensity reduction, not the Neumann constrained Lax generator

model.hamiltonian: H=(norm(p)^2+x^T A x)/2 on norm(x)^2=1 and x dot p=0
model.quantization: for hbar>0, -hbar^2 Delta_S2/2+x^T A x/2 on H2(S2) subset L2(S2)

nonclaims: No priority claim is made for the Neumann problem, Uhlenbeck integrals, Lax representation, quadrics correspondence, or Liouville integrability.
No explicit genus-two Abel inversion or complete singular-fiber topology is claimed.
No closed-form anisotropic quantum spectrum is claimed.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, target divisor, functional equation, target-zero match, Hilbert-Polya operator, or Route-B input is claimed.

theorem_contract.boundaries: axial linear types, invariant coordinate circles, the repeated-spectrum commuting pair with its energy identity and open-set independence witness, and the isotropic great-circle face are separate
theorem_contract.global: the constrained Neumann flow is complete for every initial state
theorem_contract.integrals: the three Uhlenbeck integrals are conserved and pairwise Dirac-Poisson commuting with sum F_i=1 and sum a_i F_i=2H
theorem_contract.quantum_boundary: for hbar>0 the natural compact Schrodinger quantization on H2(S2) is self-adjoint with compact resolvent but no closed anisotropic spectrum or target-zero claim is made
theorem_contract.regular_fibers: every connected regular compact common fiber is a Liouville two-torus and the physical flow closes iff its frequency vector has a common period
